title: Program
description: A program as it is saved (PROGRAMS_PLAN.md): the save body laid over the stored program, or a programs/*.yaml file. Checked before anything else on every save path (manage_program upsert, REST, the seed). What a schema cannot say (the parent exists and does not loop, the workflows exist and belong to no other program, the topics, agents and APIs exist) is checked next by services/programs.rs. Self-contained (remote $ref resolution is disabled).

name.description: Slug, at most 64 characters; the file stem. Its identity: it does not change.

label.description: What the HBI shows; the name when empty.

kind.description: department: standing work. project: a deliverable, then it ends. investigation / case: a question that closes with a finding. services: on-demand workflows every program uses.

parent.description: The program it sits under; null or absent = top level.

status.description: Not active pauses its workflows and those of the programs under it, except keep_running.

charter.description: What it is for, in a few sentences. Its manager judges it against this.

workflows.description: Workflows it owns. A workflow belongs to at most one program.

keep_running.description: Its workflows that a pause or close leaves on.

agents.description: Agent profiles its work relies on.

apis.description: API contexts and MCP servers its work relies on.

every.description: How often its manager reviews it (1w, 30d).

monthly_usd.description: A monthly cap in US dollars; shown, not enforced yet.

finding.description: What a closed investigation or case found (required to close one).
